    <script type="module">
        $(document).ready(function()
        {
            'use strict';

            //  Align suggestions on 'sm' devices
            $('#search-text').on('click', function() {
                var elOffset = $(this).offset().left;
                if (mq.is('sm')) {
                    $('.autocomplete-suggestions').css('left', elOffset);
                }
                if (mq.before('lg')) {
                    var elOffsetTop = $(this).offset().top;
                    $('.autocomplete-suggestions').css('top', elOffsetTop + 40 + 'px');
                }
            });

            var searchInput = $('.searchform-input-box');
            var latestSearchesForm = $('.main-nav__row .latest-search-box');

            function setLatestSearchHorizontal(displayType) {
                var screenWidth = $(window).width();
                var searchInputWidth = searchInput[0].offsetWidth;
                latestSearchesForm.css({
                    'display': displayType,
                    'width': searchInputWidth + 'px'
                });

                if (screenWidth <= 768) {
                    latestSearchesForm.css({
                        'width': screenWidth + 'px'
                    });
                }
            }

            setLatestSearchHorizontal('none');

            searchInput[0].addEventListener('focus', function () {
                setLatestSearchHorizontal('block');
            }, true); // Capture phase

            searchInput[0].addEventListener('blur', function () {
                setLatestSearchHorizontal('none');
            }, true); // Capture phase

            var prevSearch = '';
            var serviceUrl = '';

            var autocompleteOptions = {
                ajaxSettings: {
                    headers: {
                        Accept: 'application/json'
                    }
                },
                paramName: 'keyword',
                minChars: 3,
                deferRequestBy: 100,
                triggerSelectOnValidInput: false, // https://github.com/devbridge/jQuery-Autocomplete/issues/644
                groupBy: 'category',
                onSelect: function(suggestion) {
                    if (suggestion.data && suggestion.data.id != undefined) {

                        var search_category = $('#search-category').val();
                        var url = '';

                        if (search_category == 'support') {
                            url = '/?fuseaction=support.page&id=' + suggestion.data.id;
                        } else {
                            url = '/?fuseaction=search.search&q[cat]=' + suggestion.data.id + '&q[q]=' + suggestion.value;
                        }

                        if (suggestion.data && suggestion.data.category === 'user') {
                            url = '/?fuseaction=listing.seller&q[seller]=' + suggestion.data.name;
                        }

                        document.location.href = url;

                    } else {
                        if (suggestion.value != prevSearch) {
                            $('#main-search').submit();
                        }
                    }
                },
                onSearchStart: function(query) {
                    var id = $('#search-category').val();
                    if ($.isNumeric(id)) {
                        query['q[cat]'] = $('#search-category').val();
                    }
                },
                transformResult: function(response) {
                    response = $.parseJSON(response);
                    return {
                        suggestions: $.map(response, function(dataItem) {
                            return { value: dataItem.value, data: dataItem.data };
                        })
                    };
                },
                beforeRender: function(container) {
                    $('.autocomplete-group:contains(user)').addClass('border-0');
                    const $autoCompleteSuggestions = $('.autocomplete-suggestions');
                    // use attr to replace previously bound custom classes
                    $autoCompleteSuggestions.attr('class', 'autocomplete-suggestions autocomplete-suggestions-top-search');
                    $autoCompleteSuggestions.prepend('<div class="suggest-text">Otsi\u0020soovitused</div>');
                    $autoCompleteSuggestions.append($('.latest-search-box-html-wrapper').html());
                    if ($('.autocomplete-suggestion').length >= 3) {
                        $('.autocomplete-suggestions .latest-popular-searches').addClass('d-none');
                    }
                    window.rebindLatestSearchBoxListeners();
                },
                formatResult: function (suggestion, currentValue) {

                    var search_category = $('#search-category').val();
                    var ret = '';

                    // Do not replace anything if the current value is empty
                    if (!currentValue) {
                        return suggestion.value;
                    }

                    if (search_category == 'support') {

                        if (suggestion.data && suggestion.data.category != undefined && suggestion.data.category == 'page') {

                            if (suggestion.data.main_category_name && suggestion.data.name != suggestion.data.main_category_name) {
                                ret = suggestion.data.main_category_name + ' - ';
                            }
                            ret += suggestion.data.name;
                        }

                    } else {

                        var pattern = '(' + currentValue.replace(/[|\\{}()[\]^$+*?.]/g, "\\$&") + ')';

                        ret = suggestion.value
                            .replace(new RegExp(pattern, 'gi'), '<strong>$1<\/strong>')
                            .replace(/&/g, '&amp;')
                            .replace(/</g, '&lt;')
                            .replace(/>/g, '&gt;')
                            .replace(/"/g, '&quot;')
                            .replace(/&lt;(\/?strong)&gt;/g, '<$1>');

                        if (suggestion.data && suggestion.data.category != undefined && suggestion.data.category == 'category') {
                            ret = ret + ' - <span class="category">' + suggestion.data.name + '</span>';
                        }

                        if (suggestion.data && suggestion.data.category === 'user') {
                            ret = ret + ' <span class="category">(kasutaja)</span>';
                        }
                    }

                    return ret;
                }
            };

            $('#search-category').bind('change blur click', function() {

                if ($(this).val() == 'support') {

                    $('#main-search').attr('action', '/?fuseaction=');
                    $('#search-text').attr('name', 'search');
                    $('#search-text').attr('placeholder', 'Otsi\u0020ABI\u002Dst...').attr('aria-label', 'Otsi\u0020ABI\u002Dst...');
                    $('#search-fuseaction').val('support.search').prop('disabled', false);

                    autocompleteOptions.serviceUrl = '/support/autocomplete';

                    try {
                        $('#search-text').autocomplete(autocompleteOptions);
                    } catch (error) {
                    }

                } else if ($(this).val() == 'forum') {

                    $('#main-search').attr('action', '/foorum/search');
                    $('#search-text').attr('name', 'search');
                    $('#search-text').attr('placeholder', 'Otsi\u0020foorumist...').attr('aria-label', 'Otsi\u0020foorumist...');
                    $('#search-fuseaction').prop('disabled', true);

                    try {
                        $('#search-text').autocomplete().dispose();
                    } catch (error) {
                    }
                } else {

                    $('#main-search').attr('action', '/?fuseaction=search.search');
                    $('#search-text').attr('name', 'q[q]');
                    $('#search-text').attr('placeholder', 'Otsi\u0020toodet...').attr('aria-label', 'Otsi\u0020toodet...');
                    $('#search-fuseaction').val('search.search').prop('disabled', false);

                    autocompleteOptions.serviceUrl = '/search/autocomplete';

                    try {
                        $('#search-text').autocomplete(autocompleteOptions);
                    } catch (error) {
                    }
                }
            });

            $('#search-category').trigger('blur');
        });
    </script>
</div>

                        </div>
                        <div class="main-nav__row">

    <script type="module">
        $(function() {

            'use strict';

            var $searchInput = $('.searchform-input-box');
                            $searchInput[0].addEventListener('focus', function () {
                    $('.latest-search-box').removeClass('d-none');
                }, true); // Capture phase
            
            var onSearchesMouseDown = function(event) {
                event.preventDefault();
            };

            var onSearchboxButtonClick = function(event) {
                event.stopPropagation();
                var $target = $(event.target);
                // target both copied and hidden buttons for syncing
                $target = $('.latest-search-box-button[data-id="' + $target.data('id') + '"]');
                $target.prop('disabled', true);
                $target.closest('li').css('background-color', '#CCCCCC');
                $target.closest('li').find('*').css('color', '#5E5E5E');
                $.ajax('/?fuseaction=search.removeSaved', {
                    method: 'POST',
                    data: {
                        search_ids: [$target.data('id')]
                    },
                    success: function(serverData) {
                        if (serverData.error != null && serverData.error.length) {
                            window.toast({
                                type: 'danger',
                                text: 'Midagi läks valesti',
                                visible: 2500
                            });
                            $target.prop('disabled', false);
                        } else if (serverData.success) {
                            $target.closest('li').remove();
                        }
                    }
                });
            };

            window.rebindLatestSearchBoxListeners = function() {
                var $latestSearchBox = $('.latest-search-box');
                var $latestSearchBoxButton = $('.latest-search-box-button');

                $latestSearchBox.off('mousedown', onSearchesMouseDown);
                $latestSearchBox.on('mousedown', onSearchesMouseDown);

                $latestSearchBoxButton.off('click', onSearchboxButtonClick);
                $latestSearchBoxButton.on('click', onSearchboxButtonClick);
            };
        });
    </script>

<script type="module">
    $(function(){
        window.rebindLatestSearchBoxListeners();
    });

<script type="module">
function registerServiceWorker()
{
    'use strict';

    return navigator.serviceWorker.register('/assets/scripts/webpush-sw.js')
        .then(function(registration) {
            //console.log('Service worker successfully registered.');
            return registration;
        })
        .catch(function(err) {
            //console.error('Unable to register service worker.', err);
        });
}

function urlBase64ToUint8Array(base64String)
{
    'use strict';

    const padding = '='.repeat((4 - base64String.length % 4) % 4);
    const base64 = (base64String + padding).replace(/\-/g, '+').replace(/_/g, '/');

    const rawData = window.atob(base64);
    const outputArray = new Uint8Array(rawData.length);

    for (let i = 0; i < rawData.length; ++i) {
        outputArray[i] = rawData.charCodeAt(i);
    }
    return outputArray;
}

function registerUserForPush()
{
    'use strict';

    // Permission already granted
    if (Notification.permission === 'granted') {
        //console.log('Permission already granted');
        return true;
    }

    return navigator.serviceWorker.getRegistration('/assets/scripts/webpush-sw.js')
        .then(function(registration) {
            //console.log('Service worker successfully registered');
            const subscribeOptions = {
                userVisibleOnly: true,
                applicationServerKey: urlBase64ToUint8Array('BJTEAIh5EmpFpHgzxFFli-B67H-m1zCSUcXHX6GXk6EhZ0D_Z-7ZCFZH5zQHqsqK-9uN_z7jVQc4n5mksuzfUdw')
            };

            return registration.pushManager.subscribe(subscribeOptions);
        })
        .then(function(pushSubscription) {
            //console.log('Received PushSubscription: ', JSON.stringify(pushSubscription));

            let subscription = pushSubscription.toJSON();

            let data = {
                endpoint: subscription.endpoint,
                authToken: subscription.keys.auth,
                publicKey: subscription.keys.p256dh,
            };

            // Save subscriber
            $.ajax({
                url: '/webpush/subscribe',
                type: 'POST',
                headers: {
                    'Accept':'application/json',
                },
                data: data,
                error: function() {
                    $('#webpush-error').html('Teavituste\u0020aktiveerimine\u0020eba\u00F5nnestus').removeClass('d-none');
                    return false;
                },
                success: function() {
                    $('#webpush-modal').modal('hide');
                }
            });
            return pushSubscription;
        }).catch(function() {
            //console.error('Failed registering push subscription.', err);
            $('#webpush-error').html('Teavituste\u0020aktiveerimine\u0020eba\u00F5nnestus.\u0020Luba\u0020teavitused\u0020browseri\u0020seadetest\u0020v\u00F5i\u0020kliki\u0020aadressiriba\u0020ees\u0020asuvale\u0020\u0022\u003Ci\u003Eluku\u003C\/i\u003E\u0022\u0020m\u00E4rgile\u0020ja\u0020luba\u0020teavitused.\u003C\/br\u003E\r\n\u003Cimg\u0020class\u003D\u0022w\u002D100\u0022\u0020src\u003D\u0022https\u003A\/\/files.osta.ee\/_marketing\/push_blocked2.jpg\u0022\u003E').removeClass('d-none');
            return false;
        });
}

function setPushStatus(status, type, toggleId, callback, agentId)
{
    'use strict';

    $.ajax({
        url: '/webpush/status',
        type: 'POST',
        headers: {
            'Accept':'application/json',
        },
        data: {
            type: type,
            status: status
        },
        success: function(data) {
            if (type === 1) {
                $('.js-bid-push-toggle').prop('checked', data.status === 1);

                let $overbidText = $('.js-notification-overbid');
                $overbidText.text(data.status === 1
                    ? $overbidText.data('text-enabled')
                    : $overbidText.data('text-disabled')
                );
            } else {
                toggleId.prop('checked', data.status === 1);
            }

            if (callback && typeof window[callback] === 'function') {
                window[callback](agentId);
            }
        }
    });
}

function initPushStatus() {
    if (Notification.permission !== 'granted') {
        // untoggle locally to indicate lack of permission, even if subscribed in DB
        $('.js-toggle-webpush').prop('checked', false);

        let $overbidText = $('.js-notification-overbid');
        $overbidText.text($overbidText.data('text-disabled'));
    }
}

$(function()
{
    'use strict';

    if (!('serviceWorker' in navigator)) {
        // Service Worker isn't supported on this browser, disable or hide UI
        //console.log("Service Worker isn't supported on this browser, disable or hide UI.");
        return;
    }

    if (!('PushManager' in window)) {
        // Push isn't supported on this browser, disable or hide UI.
        //console.log("Push isn't supported on this browser, disable or hide UI.");
        return;
    }

    // Register service worker to listen for pushes
    registerServiceWorker();

    // Show toggle boxes
    $('.browser-notification__toggle').removeClass('d-none');

    // On window rather than in this module's scope: a Turbo Drive visit re-evaluates this script with
    // a fresh scope, so a poll left running by the previous render could only be cleared from here.
    window.__ostaWebpushPoll = window.__ostaWebpushPoll ?? null;
    clearInterval(window.__ostaWebpushPoll);

    let counter = 0;

    // Listen for subscription button toggle
    $('[name="toggle-webpush"]').on('click', function() {

        let type = $(this).data('type');
        let callback = $(this).data('callback');
        let agentId = $(this).data('agentId');
        let toggleId = type === 1 ? $(this).closest('.browser-notification__toggle').attr('id') : $(this);

        type !== 1 && $(this).data('checked', $(this).prop('checked'));
        type !== 1 && $(this).prop('checked', !$(this).prop('checked'));

        if (type !== 1 && !$(this).data('checked')) {
            if (callback && typeof window[callback] === 'function') {
                window[callback](agentId);
            }
            return;
        }

        if (Notification.permission !== 'granted') {

            // Show messages in modal how to re-enable pushes
            if (Notification.permission === 'denied') {
                $('#webpush-browser-reject').removeClass('d-none');
            } else {
                $('#webpush-browser-reject').addClass('d-none');
            }

            $('#webpush-modal').modal('show');

            // Check until we have permission or deny
            clearInterval(window.__ostaWebpushPoll);
            window.__ostaWebpushPoll = setInterval(function() {
                counter++;

                if (Notification.permission === 'granted') {
                    clearInterval(window.__ostaWebpushPoll);

                    // Subscribe
                    setPushStatus(1, type, toggleId, callback, agentId);
                } else if (Notification.permission === 'denied') {
                    clearInterval(window.__ostaWebpushPoll);
                }

                if (counter >= 100) {
                    clearInterval(window.__ostaWebpushPoll);
                }

            }, 1000);

        } else {
            // (Un)subscribe
            let status = type !== 1 ? $(this).data('checked') : $(this).is(':checked');
            setPushStatus((status ? 1 : 0), type, toggleId, callback, agentId);
        }
    });

    $('#webpush-accept').on('click', function() {
        registerUserForPush();
    });

    initPushStatus();
});
</script>

<script type="module">
function updateSearchFacets(data)
{
    let facets = data.facets;
    if (typeof facets != 'object' || !facets.category1) {
        return;
    }

    $('.facet-count').html(' (0)');

    if (facets.ship_courier_smartpost != undefined) {
        if (facets.ship_courier_smartpost > 0) {
            $('#count-courier-smartpost, #count-m-courier-smartpost').html(' (' + facets.ship_courier_smartpost + ')');
        } else if (!$('#chk-courier-smartpost').prop('checked')) {
            $('#chk-courier-smartpost, #chk-m-courier-smartpost').prop('disabled', true).parent('label').addClass('btn-disabled');
        }
    }

    if (facets.ship_courier_post24 != undefined) {
        if (facets.ship_courier_post24 > 0) {
            $('#count-courier-post24, #count-m-courier-post24').html(' (' + facets.ship_courier_post24 + ')');
        } else if (!$('#chk-courier-post24').prop('checked')) {
            $('#chk-courier-post24, #chk-m-courier-post24').prop('disabled', true).parent('label').addClass('btn-disabled');
        }
    }

    if (facets.ship_courier_dpd != undefined) {
        if (facets.ship_courier_dpd > 0) {
            $('#count-courier-dpd, #count-m-courier-dpd').html(' (' + facets.ship_courier_dpd + ')');
        } else if (!$('#chk-courier-dpd').prop('checked')) {
            $('#chk-courier-dpd, #chk-m-courier-dpd').prop('disabled', true).parent('label').addClass('btn-disabled');
        }
    }

    if (facets.ship_courier_unisend != undefined) {
        if (facets.ship_courier_unisend > 0) {
            $('#count-courier-unisend, #count-m-courier-unisend').html(' (' + facets.ship_courier_unisend + ')');
        } else if (!$('#chk-courier-unisend').prop('checked')) {
            $('#chk-courier-unisend, #chk-m-courier-unisend').prop('disabled', true).parent('label').addClass('btn-disabled');
        }
    }

    if (facets.ship_courier_venipak != undefined) {
        if (facets.ship_courier_venipak > 0) {
            $('#count-courier-venipak, #count-m-courier-venipak').html(' (' + facets.ship_courier_venipak + ')');
        } else if (!$('#chk-courier-venipak').prop('checked')) {
            $('#chk-courier-venipak, #chk-m-courier-venipak').prop('disabled', true).parent('label').addClass('btn-disabled');
        }
    }

    if (facets.ship_courier_cargobus != undefined) {
        if (facets.ship_courier_cargobus > 0) {
            $('#count-courier-cargobus, #count-m-courier-cargobus').html(' (' + facets.ship_courier_cargobus + ')');
        } else if (!$('#chk-courier-cargobus').prop('checked')) {
            $('#chk-courier-cargobus, #chk-m-courier-cargobus').prop('disabled', true).parent('label').addClass('btn-disabled');
        }
    }

    if (facets.discount != undefined) {
        if (facets.discount > 0) {
            $('#count-discount, #count-m-discount').html(' (' + facets.discount + ')');
        } else if (!$('#chk-discount').prop('checked')) {
            $('#chk-discount, #chk-m-discount').prop('disabled', true).parent('label').addClass('btn-disabled');
        }
    }

    if (facets.free_shipment != undefined) {
        if (facets.free_shipment > 0) {
            $('#count-free-shipment, #count-m-free-shipment').html(' (' + facets.free_shipment + ')');
        } else if (!$('#chk-free-shipment').prop('checked')) {
            $('#chk-free-shipment, #chk-m-free-shipment').prop('disabled', true).parent('label').addClass('btn-disabled');
        }
    }

    if (facets.prereg != undefined) {
        if (facets.prereg > 0) {
            $('#count-prereg, #count-m-prereg').html(' (' + facets.prereg + ')');
        } else if (!$('#chk-prereg').prop('checked')) {
            $('#chk-prereg, #chk-m-prereg').prop('disabled', true).parent('label').addClass('btn-disabled');
        }
    }

    if (facets.price_offer != undefined) {
        if (facets.price_offer > 0) {
            $('#count-price-offer, #count-m-price-offer').html(' (' + facets.price_offer + ')');
        } else if (!$('#chk-price-offer').prop('checked')) {
            $('#chk-price-offer, #chk-m-price-offer').prop('disabled', true).parent('label').addClass('btn-disabled');
        }
    }

    if (facets.design != undefined) {
        if (facets.design > 0) {
            $('#count-design, #count-m-design').html(' (' + facets.design + ')');
        } else if (!$('#chk-design').prop('checked')) {
            $('#chk-design, #chk-m-design').prop('disabled', true).parent('label').addClass('btn-disabled');
        }
    }

    if (facets.exclude_cat != undefined && typeof facets.exclude_cat == 'object') {
        let total = Object.values(facets.condition).reduce((part, a) => part + a, 0);
        let removedExcludes = 0;
        let selectedExcludes = new URLSearchParams(location.search).getAll('q[exclude_cat][]');

        let categoriesBooks = [1247,1547,1626,1552,1553,1252,1260,1554,1555,1556,1557,1558,1628,1560,1561,1562,1563,1564,1565,1566,1567,1568,1569,1570,1571,1257,1255,1572,1573,1574,1575,1576,1577,1578,1579,2181,1621,1251,1250,1586,1587,1588,1525,1589,1590,1591,1592,1593,1594,1595,1596,1256,1598,1599,1600,1601,1602,1603,1597,1604,1605,1606,1607,1262,1608,1609,1610,1613,1614,1615,1259,1616,1617,1618,1620,1258,1619,1261,1622,1623,1624,1656,1657,1658,1659,1249,1662,1663,1664,1248,1253,1611,1612,772,1625,1551,1627,1559,1629,1630,1631,1632,1633,1634,1635,1636,1637,1638,1639,1640,1641,1642,1643,1644,1645,1646,1647,1648,1649,1650,1651,1652,1653,1654,1655,1254,1665,1666,1667,1668,1669,1670,1530];
        let categoriesColl = [51,2360,2361,2649,2650,2651,2652,2653,2654,1196,2655,1195,2656,2657,2658,2659,2660,2138,2416,2139,773,1194,210,691,689,690,217,227,224,228,218,220,222,225,221,223,226,219,768,211,214,212,213,215,2648,2123,209,688,1199,674,676,673,679,678,1716,2522,672,677,675,2429,589,2179,2178,2180,1193,635,622,623,624,625,2126,626,627,630,629,628,2125,631,633,634,2141,2143,2142,2144,44,2531,2532,2533,2534,2535,2553,2536,2537,2538,2539,2540,2541,2542,2543,2545,2544,2503,1192,117,725,759,726,727,728,729,730,2311,2327,2312,2313,2314,2326,2324,2328,2322,2325,2321,2317,2323,2318,2320,2319,2315,2316,2329,2310,2330,2331,2354,2349,2355,2333,2334,2337,2340,2335,2336,2338,2339,2341,2332,2358,2348,2350,2351,2352,2353,2357,2342,2344,2346,2345,2347,2343,2356,2359,1198,43,2140,714,1278,1722,1200,1191];
        let catsExcludeBooks = Object.keys(facets.category1)
            .filter(catId => !categoriesBooks.includes(parseInt(catId)));
        let catsExcludeColl = Object.keys(facets.category1)
            .filter(catId => !categoriesColl.includes(parseInt(catId)));
        let booksRoot = 1530;
        let collRoot = 1191;
        let alwaysRemove = true;

        let facetDiff = selectedExcludes.length === 1
            ? Math.abs(facets.exclude_cat[booksRoot] - facets.exclude_cat[collRoot]) + 1
            : 0
        ;

        $.each(facets.exclude_cat, function (index, value) {
            if (!selectedExcludes.includes(index)) {
                $('#count-exclude-cat-' + index + ', #count-m-exclude-cat-' + index).html(' (' + value + ')');
                let $filters = $('input[name="q[exclude_cat][]"][value="' + index + '"]');
                let remove = alwaysRemove
                    || (parseInt(index) === booksRoot && !catsExcludeBooks.length)
                    || (parseInt(index) === collRoot && !catsExcludeColl.length)
                    || (value - facetDiff) >= total
                ;
                remove
                    ? $filters.parent('label').addClass('d-none') && $filters.find('+label').addClass('d-none')
                    : $filters.parent('label').removeClass('d-none') && $filters.find('+label').removeClass('d-none');

                removedExcludes += remove;
            }
        });

        if (removedExcludes === Object.keys(facets.exclude_cat).length) {
            $('#item-exclude').parent('.panel').addClass('d-none');
            $('#filter-exclude-btn').addClass('d-none');
            $('#exclude-btn').addClass('d-none');
        } else {
            $('#item-exclude').parent('.panel').removeClass('d-none');
            $('#filter-exclude-btn').removeClass('d-none');
            $('#exclude-btn').removeClass('d-none');
        }
    }

    if (facets.condition != undefined && typeof facets.condition == 'object') {
        $.each(facets.condition, function (index, value) {
            $('#count-condition-' + index + ', #count-m-condition-' + index).html(' (' + value + ')');
        });
    }
    if (facets != undefined) {
        $.each($('.facet-count-condition'), function (index, value) {
            if (!$(this).prev('input[type="checkbox"]').prop('checked') && $(this).html() == ' (0)') {
                $(this).prev('input[type="checkbox"]').prop('disabled', true).parent('label').addClass('btn-disabled');
            }
        });
    }

    var filters = new Array('shoes_size', 'clothes_size', 'shoes_size_kids', 'clothes_size_kids', 'jeans_waist', 'jeans_length', 'bra_girth', 'bra_cup', 'sleeve_length', 'skirt_length', 'men_suit_size', 'men_shirt_size', 'baby_clothes_size', 'baby_age', 'den_size', 'pantyhose_size', 'jacket_size', 'coat_length', 'coat_style', 'candle_type', 'bicycle_type', 'bicycle_user_type', 'bicycle_wheel_size', 'bicycle_frame_size', 'bicycle_gears', 'movie_genre', 'music_genre', 'language', 're_deal_type', 'coin_grade', 'stamp_cancellation');

    for (var i = 0; i < filters.length; i++) {


        if (facets[filters[i]] != undefined && typeof facets[filters[i]] == 'object') {
            $.each(facets[filters[i]], function (index, value) {
                var $counts = $('#count-' + filters[i] + '-' + index + ', #count-m-' + filters[i] + '-' + index);
                if (index != 0 && value > 0) {
                    $counts.parents('.panel').removeClass('d-none');
                }
                $counts.html(' (' + value + ')');
            });
        }

        $.each($('.facet-count-' + filters[i]), function (index, value) {
            if (!$(this).prev('input[type="checkbox"]').prop('checked') && $(this).html() == ' (0)') {
                $(this).prev('input[type="checkbox"]').prop('disabled', true).parent('label').addClass('btn-disabled');
            }
        });
    }
    $('.panel.d-none').remove();
}

let originalFiltersCnt = null;

let openingsSet = false;

$(document).ready(function ()
{
    'use strict';

    // Initiate listeners
    $('#btn-reset').on('click', function () {
        let $form = $('#form-filter');
        $form.find('input[type=text], input[type=number], textarea').val('');
        $form.find('input[type=checkbox]').prop('checked', false).parent('label').removeClass('active');
        $form.find('.panel').removeClass('active');
    });

    $('#btn-reset-m').on('click', function () {
        let $form = $('#form-filter-m');
        $form.find('input[type=text], input[type=number], textarea, select').val('');
        $form.find('input[type=checkbox]').prop('checked', false).parent('label').removeClass('active');
        updateFilterGroups(1);
    });

    $('#form-filter .btn-check').on('click', function () {
        let isDesktopExclude = document.getElementById('fexclude-copy').contains(this)
            && this.id.startsWith('chk-exclude-')
            && mq.after('md')
        ;

        if (!this.classList.contains('btn-disabled') && !isDesktopExclude) {
            setTimeout(function () {
                // requestSubmit(), not .submit(): only a real submit event reaches Turbo's document
                // listener, and without it every facet change stays a full page load.
                $('#form-filter')[0]?.requestSubmit();
            }, 100);
        }
    });

    setTimeout(() => {
        addMissingQueryFields($('#form-filter-m'), ['start']);
        addMissingQueryFields($('#form-filter-s'), ['start']);
        addMissingQueryFields($('#form-filter'), ['start']);
    });

        var url = '/search/filter/aggregations?id=938';

    $.ajax({
        url: url,
        type: 'GET',
        success: function (data) {
            updateSearchFacets({'facets': data});
        },
        headers: {
            Accept: 'application/json'
        }
    });

    updateCategories();

    
    $('.panel').find('input, select, textarea').on('change', updateFilterGroups);

    $('#btn-exclude-confirm').on('click', function () {
        setTimeout(function () {
            $('#form-filter')[0]?.requestSubmit();
        }, 100);
    });

    $('#m-filter .collapse').onClassChange((elem, className) => {
        if (className.indexOf('show') > -1 && $('#m-filter').hasClass('show')) {
            $(elem).parents('.panel')[0].scrollIntoView({behavior: 'smooth', block: 'center'});
        }
    });

    // Bound through a namespace that is cleared first: window survives a Turbo Drive body swap, so a
    // plain .on() would leave one copy of this reflow per visit registered, and the reflow is not
    // idempotent — it clicks the filter accordions shut and back open again on every extra run.
    $(window).off('resize.listingFilters').on('resize.listingFilters', function () {
        let $sellTypes = $('#m-type input');
        let sellTypeButtons = [];

        if ($sellTypes.length) {
            $sellTypes.each(function (index) {
                // Rewrote string building to generate proper BS5 sibling inputs & labels
                let inputId = 'm-sell-type-opt-' + index;
                let labelText = $(this).next('label').text() || $(this).parent('label').text();

                sellTypeButtons.push(
                    '<input type="radio" class="btn-check" id="' + inputId + '" name="item-type2" autocomplete="off" value="' +
                    $(this).val() + '" ' + ($(this).attr('checked') ? ' checked' : '') +
                    (!sellTypeButtons.length ? ' data-ignore="1"' : '') +
                    ' />' +
                    '<label class="btn btn-radio btn-block-legacy d-block w-100" for="' + inputId + '">' +
                    labelText +
                    '</label>'
                );
            });

            let $btnGroup = $('#m-sell-type .btn-group');
            $btnGroup.html(sellTypeButtons.join('')).find('input').on('change', function () {
                $('#form-filter-m').data('submitting', true);
                $('#m-type').find('input[value="' + $(this).val() + '"]').click()
            });

            if (!$btnGroup.find('input:checked').length) {
                $btnGroup.find('input').first().attr('checked', true);
            }
            // Removed the manual .addClass('active') since CSS handles it now
        } else {
            $('#m-sell-type').parents('.panel').addClass('d-none');
        }

        if ($(this).width() <= tabletWidth) {
            $('#listing-filter').appendTo('#otherFilters');
            $('#otherFilters').find('.collapsed').click();

            $('#m-catlist').append($('#sub-cat-list .cat-list__sub-list')).append($('#sub-cat-list .cat-list'));
        } else {
            $('#listing-filter').appendTo('#listing-filter-form');

            $('#sub-cat-list').append($('#m-catlist .cat-list__sub-list')).append($('#m-catlist .cat-list'));
            $('#pre-message').prependTo('.main-content__section');
        }
    }).off('beforeunload.listingFilters').on('beforeunload.listingFilters', () => {
        $('.filters').addClass('unloading');
    }).trigger('resize.listingFilters');

    // A Turbo visit replaces the body without ever firing beforeunload, so the open drawer needs the
    // same dimming from Turbo's own event; the class goes away with the body the render swaps out.
    $(document).off('turbo:visit.listingFilters').on('turbo:visit.listingFilters', () => {
        $('.filters').addClass('unloading');
    });

    $('.filters').onClassChange(() => {
        setTimeout(() => {
            let $body = $('body');
            $('.filters.show').length ? $body.addClass('mobile-no-scroll') : $body.removeClass('mobile-no-scroll');
        });
    });

    // The observer above dies with the `.filters` a `#listing-results` frame render throws away, so
    // the scroll lock is re-derived from the DOM Turbo swapped in.
    $(document).off('turbo:frame-render.listingFilters turbo:frame-load.listingFilters').on('turbo:frame-render.listingFilters turbo:frame-load.listingFilters', () => {
        if (!$('.filters.show').length) {
            $('body').removeClass('mobile-no-scroll');
        }
    });

    $('#m-exclude input').on('change', function () {
        let $that = $(this);
        $('#m-filter').find('input[name="' + $(this).attr('name') + '"]').each(function () {
            if ($(this).val() === $that.val()) {
                $(this).prop('checked', $that.prop('checked'));
            }
        });
    });

    if ($(window).width() <= tabletWidth || false) {
        setTimeout(() => {
            updateFilterGroups(2);
        });
    }
});

const updateFilterGroups = (mode) => { // 1 = reset button, 2 = initial
    let selectedFiltersCnt = 0, selectedExcludeCnt = 0;
    let allFilters = [];

    $('#mobile-offers-filter > .panel').each(function () {
        let skipCnt = 0;
        $(this).find('.selected-filters').remove();
        let panelFilters = [];

        $(this).find('input, select, textarea').each(function () {
            if (skipCnt) {
                skipCnt--;
                return;
            }
            if ($(this).data('ignore')) {
                return;
            }
            let useValue = $(this).val();
            let useName = $(this).attr('name');
            let type = $(this).attr('type');
            let label = ($(this).next('label').text() || $(this).parent().parent().find('label').text()).split('(')[0].trim() + ' ';
            let isExclude = useName.indexOf('exclude_cat') !== -1


            if (isExclude && $(this).prop('checked')) {
                selectedExcludeCnt ++;
            }

            if ($(this)[0].tagName === 'SELECT') {
                if (useValue === $(this).find('option').first().val() || !$(this).find('option:selected').length) {
                    useValue = '';
                } else {
                    useValue = $(this).find('option:selected').text();
                }
            }

            if (type === 'hidden') {
                return;
            } else if (type === 'checkbox' || type === 'radio') {
                if (!$(this).prop('checked')) {
                    return;
                }
                useValue = ($(this).next('label').text() || $(this).parent().text()).split('(')[0].trim();
            } else if ($(this).parent('div').hasClass('input-group')) {
                useValue = '';
                skipCnt = -1;

                let groupValues = [];
                $(this).parent('div').find('input, select').each(function () {
                    skipCnt++;
                    let tmpVal = $(this).val();
                    if ($(this)[0].tagName === 'SELECT') {
                        tmpVal = !$(this).find('option').first().prop('selected') ? $(this).find('option:selected').text() : '';
                    }
                    groupValues.push(tmpVal);
                });

                if (groupValues.length > 1 && groupValues.join('') !== '') {
                    for (let i in groupValues) {
                        if (!groupValues[i]) groupValues[i] = '...';
                    }
                    useValue = '<small>' + label + '</small>' + groupValues.join(' - ');
                }
            } else if ($(this)[0].tagName === 'SELECT' && useValue) {
                useValue = '<small>' + label + '</small>' + useValue;
            }

            if (useValue.trim() !== '' && ($(window).width() > tabletWidth || !isExclude)) {
                panelFilters.push(useValue);
                let useId = btoa(useName + useValue, true);
                $(this).attr('data-filter-id', useId);
                allFilters.push({
                    elem: useId,
                    tagName: $(this)[0].tagName,
                    value: useValue,
                });
            }
        });


        if (panelFilters.length) {
            $(this).find('.panel-title a').append('<div class="selected-filters">' + panelFilters.join(', ') + '</div>');
            selectedFiltersCnt += panelFilters.length;
        }
    });

    if ($(window).width() > tabletWidth) {
        selectedFiltersCnt -= selectedExcludeCnt;
    }


    let $btnReset = $('#btn-reset-m');
    $btnReset
        .removeClass('disabled')
        .addClass(selectedFiltersCnt ? '' : 'disabled');
    if (mode === 1) {
        if (originalFiltersCnt) {
            $('#otherFilters input[type="hidden"][name^="q["]').remove();
            $('#form-filter-m button[type="submit"]').click();
        } else {
            $('.filters').removeClass('show');
        }
        $('.mobile-filter-box .badge').html(selectedFiltersCnt);
    } else if (mode === 2) {
        originalFiltersCnt = selectedFiltersCnt;
        $('.js-filter-btn .badge').html(selectedFiltersCnt ? selectedFiltersCnt : '');
        $('#filter-exclude-btn .badge').html(selectedExcludeCnt ? selectedExcludeCnt : '');

        let allTags = [];
        for (let tag of allFilters) {
            allTags.push('<a class="tag" data-elem="' + tag['elem'] + '">' + tag['value'] + '</a>');
        }

        $('#tag-list').html(allTags.join('')).find('a').on('click', function () {
            let $input = $('[data-filter-id="' + $(this).data('elem') + '"]');
            if ($input.attr('type') === 'checkbox') {
                $input.click();
            } else if ($input.attr('type') === 'radio') {
                $input.parents('.btn-group').find('input[type="radio"]').first().click();
            } else {
                $input.val('');
                $input.parents('.input-group').find('input').val('');
            }

            $(this).addClass('disabled');
            let $form = $('#form-filter-m');

            $('#otherFilters button').remove();
            setTimeout(() => {
                if (!$form.data('submitting')) {
                    $form[0]?.requestSubmit();
                }
            });
        });
    }

    if (preSearch && preSearch.state() !== 'resolved') {
        preSearch.abort();
    }

    if ($(window).width() <= tabletWidth || false) {
        let searchUrl = '/search/filter/count?pagesize=0&id=938&' + $('#form-filter-m').serialize();

        preSearch = $.getJSON(searchUrl, null, (res) => {
            if (res[0]) {
                $('#results-amount').html(res[0].total);
            } else if (typeof res !== 'undefined') {
                $('#results-amount').html(res);
            }
        });
    }
}
window.updateCategories = function () {
    let $searchElastica = $('#search-elastica');

    if ($(window).width() <= tabletWidth) {
        $searchElastica.prependTo('#m-header2');
        $('#m-header2').find('.btn.disabled').parent('div').remove();
        $('#m-catlist').append($('#search-elastica .cat-list__sub-list'));
        $searchElastica.find('.cat-list__section').remove();
        $searchElastica.find('button').on('click', function () {
            $searchElastica.find('.open').removeClass('open');
            $('#m-catlist').toggleClass('show');
        });
        $searchElastica.find('.main-sidebar__hgroup').removeClass('d-none').addClass('d-block');
    }
}

<script type="module">
    $(function() {
        var $emailInputField = $('#searchagent-email-modal-email');
        var $searchWordText = $('#searchagent-email-modal .js-search-agent-search-word');
        var $categoryText = $('#searchagent-email-modal .js-search-agent-category');
        $('.js-agent-mail-toggle').on('change', function() {
            var $this = $(this);

            var checked = $this.is(':checked');
            $this.data('checked', checked);
            $this.prop('checked', !checked);
            if (checked) {
                $('#searchagent-email-modal-agent-name').html($this.data('agent-name'));
                if ($this.data('category-only')) {
                    $searchWordText.addClass('d-none');
                    $categoryText.removeClass('d-none');
                } else {
                    $searchWordText.removeClass('d-none');
                    $categoryText.addClass('d-none');
                }
                $('#searchagent-email-modal').modal('show');
                $('#searchagent-email-seller-modal').modal('show');

                var $activateBtn = $('#searchagent-email-modal-activate');
                $activateBtn.on('click', function() {
                    var email = $emailInputField.val();
                    if (!(email.includes('@') && email.replaceAll(' ', '').length >= 3)) {
                        return;
                    }
                    $activateBtn.prop('disabled', true);
                    $this.data('agent-email', email);
                    window.searchAgentMailToggle($this.data('agent-id'), function() {
                        $activateBtn.prop('disabled', false);
                    });
                });
            } else {
                window.searchAgentMailToggle($this.data('agent-id'));
            }
        });

        $('.js-agent-delete').on('click', function() {
            $.ajax({
                contentType: 'application/json',
                type: 'DELETE',
                url: '/api/search_agents/' + this.dataset.agentId,
                beforeSend: function(xhr) {
                    xhr.setRequestHeader('Authorization', 'Bearer ');
                },
                success: function() {
                    location.reload();
                }
            });
        });
    });

    window.searchAgentMailToggle = function(agentId, failCallback) {
        if (typeof agentId === 'undefined') {
            agentId = '';
        }

        agentChangeRequest($('.js-agent-mail-toggle[data-agent-id="' + agentId + '"]')[0], failCallback);
    }

    window.searchAgentPushToggle = function(agentId) {
        if (typeof agentId === 'undefined') {
            agentId = '';
        }
        agentChangeRequest($('.js-agent-push-toggle[data-agent-id="' + agentId + '"]')[0]);
    }

    var agentChangeRequest = function(elem, failCallBack) {
        if (typeof failCallBack === 'undefined') {
            failCallBack = function () {};
        }
        var $this = $(elem);

        var payload = {};

        if ($this.data('agent-id')) {
            payload.agentId = $this.data('agent-id');
        }
        if ($this.data('agent-query')) {
            payload.query = $this.data('agent-query');
        }

        var checked = $this.data('checked');

        if ($this.data('agent-type') === 'mail') {
            payload.isActiveMail = checked;
        } else {
            payload.isActivePush = checked;
        }

                                        
        
        if ($this.data('agent-type') === 'mail' && $this.data('agent-email')) {
            payload.email = $this.data('agent-email');
        }

        if ($this.data('seller-id')) {
            payload.sellerId = $this.data('seller-id');
        }

        $.ajax({
            contentType: 'application/merge-patch+json',
            type: 'PATCH',
            url: '/api/search_agents',
            data: JSON.stringify(payload),
            beforeSend: function(xhr) {
                xhr.setRequestHeader('Authorization', 'Bearer ')
            },
            success: function(serverData) {
                if ($this.data('agent-type') === 'mail') {
                    $this.prop('checked', serverData.isActiveMail);
                                            Cookies.set(
                            'anon_email' + cookie_suffix,
                            serverData.email,
                            { expires: 30, path: '/', domain: cookie_domain, secure: true }
                        );
                                    } else {
                    $this.prop('checked', serverData.isActivePush);
                }
                $('#searchagent-email-modal').modal('hide');
                $('#searchagent-email-seller-modal').modal('hide');
                $('#searchagent-email-modal-activate').prop('disabled', false);

                $('#agent-id-1').val(serverData.agentId);
            },
            error: failCallBack,
        });
    }
</script>

<script type="module">
    $(document).ready(() => {
      $('.js-type-link').on('click', function () {
        let $typeFilter = $('#m-type');
        $typeFilter.addClass('show');
        $(this).parent().css('position', 'relative');

        if ($(window).width() > tabletWidth) {
          $typeFilter.appendTo($(this).parent());
          setTimeout(() => {
            if ($typeFilter.hasClass('show')) {
              $(document).one('click', () => {
                $typeFilter.toggleClass('show');
              });
            }
          });
        }
      });

      let typeText = $('#m-type input:checked').next('label').text().trim() || $('#m-type input').first().next('label').text().trim();
      $('.js-type-link span').html(typeText);
    });
</script>

<script type="module">
    $(document).ready(() => {
      // Below tabletWidth the sheet's `::before` is the scrim, and a tap on a pseudo-element
      // targets the element itself — so a tap on the sheet's own box (never on its children) is a
      // tap outside. Above it the scrim is display: none, so this never fires there.
      $('#m-orderby').on('click', function (e) {
        if (e.target === this) {
          $(this).removeClass('show');
        }
      });

      $('.js-orderby-link').on('click', function () {
        let $orderbyFilter = $('#m-orderby');
        $orderbyFilter.addClass('show');
        $(this).parent().css('position', 'relative');

        if ($(window).width() > tabletWidth) {
          $orderbyFilter.appendTo($(this).parent());
          setTimeout(() => {
            if ($orderbyFilter.hasClass('show')) {
              $(document).one('click', () => {
                $orderbyFilter.toggleClass('show');
              });
            }
          });
        }
      });

      let orderText = $('#m-orderby input:checked').next('label').text().trim() || $('#m-orderby input').first().next('label').text().trim();

      $('.js-orderby-link span').html(orderText);
    });
</script>

    window.imagesCache = {};
    Object.entries(images).forEach(function(entry) {
        var id = entry[0], imgs = entry[1];
        window.imagesCache[id] = imgs.map(function(img) {
            if (img[1] === 'v') return { type: 'v', src: img[0] };
            var imageId = String(img[0]);
            var suffix = '/' + imageId.slice(-4) + '/' + imageId;
            return {
                src: tpl_img + suffix + ext_img,
                thumb: tpl_img_thumb + suffix + ext_thumb,
                orig: img[1] ? tpl_img_orig + suffix + ext_orig : null,
            };
        });
    });

<script type="module">
$(function()
{
    document.querySelectorAll('.js-webeid-auth-btn').forEach(btn =>
        btn.addEventListener('click', async (event) => {
            const lang = 'et';

            let redirectUrl = event.target.dataset.webeidUrl;

            try {
                const challengeResponse = await fetch('/auth/webeid/challenge', {
                    method: 'GET',
                    headers: {
                        'Content-Type': 'application/json',
                        'X-CSRF-Token': 'c1b65cd47799a46e5decc9d3e2e6d2bc',
                    }
                });

                if (!challengeResponse.ok) {
                    window.toast({
                        type: 'danger',
                        text: 'Viga ID kaardi kasutamisel. Kontrollige, et Web eID laiendus on browserile installitud või proovige uuesti'
                    });

                    throw new Error('GET challenge server error: ' + challengeResponse.status);
                }
                const {nonce} = await challengeResponse.json();

                const authToken = await webeid.authenticate(nonce, {lang});

                const authTokenResponse = await fetch('/auth/webeid/validate', {
                    method: 'POST',
                    headers: {
                        'Content-Type': 'application/json',
                        'X-CSRF-Token': 'c1b65cd47799a46e5decc9d3e2e6d2bc',
                    },
                    body: JSON.stringify({authToken})
                });
                if (!authTokenResponse.ok) {
                    window.toast({
                        type: 'danger',
                        text: 'Viga ID kaardi kasutamisel. Kontrollige, et Web eID laiendus on browserile installitud või proovige uuesti'
                    });

                    throw new Error("POST validate server error: " + authTokenResponse.status);
                }
                const authTokenResult = await authTokenResponse.json();

                //console.log("Authentication successful! Result:", authTokenResult);

                window.location.href = redirectUrl;

            } catch (error) {
                window.toast({
                    type: 'danger',
                    text: 'Viga ID kaardi kasutamisel. Kontrollige, et Web eID laiendus on browserile installitud või proovige uuesti'
                });

                //console.log("Authentication failed! Error:", error);

                throw error;
            }
        })
    );
});

window.clickWebEid = function(elemId)
{
    const event = new Event('click')
    document.getElementById(elemId).dispatchEvent(event);
}
</script>

    <script type="module">
        $(function() {
            $('.js-smartid-modal, .js-mid-modal').click(function() {
                $('#relogin-modal').modal('hide');
            });
        });

        window.showRelogin = function(referer) {
            loadContent('https://www.osta.ee/?fuseaction=member.relogin&ajaxreq=true&referer=' + referer, '#relogin-modal-body');
            $('#relogin-modal').modal('show');
        }

        window.relogin = function(serverData)
        {
            'use strict';

            if (serverData.redirect_url && serverData.redirect_url.length > 0) {
                redirect(serverData.redirect_url);
            } else {
                $('#relogin-message').html('').addClass('d-none');
                if (serverData.error != null && serverData.error.length) {
                    $('#relogin-message').html(serverData.error).removeClass('d-none');
                }
            }
        }
    </script>
